description: This file contains a Java class 'Bin2Header' which provides a command-line utility to convert a binary file into a C/C++ header file containing an array of byte data. It reads a binary file, generates a header guard, and outputs the binary data as hex values in a formatted array declaration.

classes.name: Bin2Header
classes.description: A utility class with a main method that converts binary files into C header files with byte array data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that performs the file conversion, reading input binary data and writing a formatted header file.
